why_ai: Sites, radios and field crews keep a physical network running and demand for mobile data grows with AI, but no personal licence or relationship protects the operator.
why_clarity: Coverage, speed, drops and churn are measured objectively across hundreds of millions of near-identical connections, though RF diagnosis is still tacit.
why_digital: Work starts from towers, spectrum and telemetry and ends in an online service increasingly bought and activated remotely by eSIM.

why_ai: Targeting and offer choice are substitutable by models, though competitive port-out battles keep some judgement in the loop.
why_clarity: Ported or kept is measured monthly on millions of lines, but offer uplift is rarely tested against holdouts.
why_digital: Billing, device and usage data in, decisions delivered through apps, bills, stores and care calls.

why_ai: Forecasting is automatable, but capex choices under spectrum, site and permitting constraints stay consequential and slow to resolve.
why_clarity: Exhaustion is measurable on counters, but whether the chosen fix was the best one is known months later.
why_digital: Counters and forecasts in, a capacity plan out on screens, carried out later as radios and sites in the field.

why_ai: Repairs happen in shelters and cabinets at remote sites and diagnosis of intermittent faults stays ambiguous, though triage is automatable.
why_clarity: A site is back on air or not within hours, but closure codes are noisy and diagnosis is done by feel.
why_digital: Alarms and telemetry in, but the value is a physical repair by a technician who drives to the site.

why_ai: Stamped structural analyses, landlord negotiations and municipal hearings need accountable people, while document assembly automates.
why_clarity: The steps are codified and recur across thousands of sites, though delays resolve over weeks.
why_digital: Drawings, leases and applications on screens, with approvals tied to specific towns and landlords.

why_ai: Small operators run physical networks in places nobody else covers, and roaming partners and communities depend on their relationships.
why_clarity: Coverage and roaming performance are measurable by road segment, but proving them is assembled by hand.
why_digital: A physical rural network delivering an online service, bought locally and through roaming deals.

why_ai: Installers on rooftops and towers do the work and local relationships matter, but carrier fixed wireless, fibre and satellite threaten demand.
why_clarity: Speeds, installs and cancellations are measured per customer and checked nightly.
why_digital: Physical installs and towers deliver an online service to local customers who buy from nearby providers.

why_ai: Prediction is automatable, but the install itself is hands-on and marginal paths still need a person on the roof.
why_clarity: Each install is a same-day pass or fail against the predicted speed, at high volume.
why_digital: Terrain and LiDAR data in, but the result is a physical install at a local address.

why_ai: Detection and diagnosis from telemetry are substitutable by models; remediation sometimes needs a tower visit.
why_clarity: Evening-peak experience is measured nightly per subscriber, though causes overlap.
why_digital: Radio and traffic telemetry in, configuration changes made remotely.

why_ai: High-volume labelled decisions suit models, though adversaries adapt and regulators require accountable controls.
why_clarity: Each request is approved or held and later confirmed as fraud or not, millions of times a year.
why_digital: Digital requests in, decisions and notices out, entirely inside carrier systems.

why_ai: Alarm correlation and outage scoping are pattern work that AIOps already absorbs, with FCC reporting signed off by staff.
why_clarity: Incidents recur in recognisable patterns and root causes are confirmed within hours.
why_digital: Alarms in, incidents and reports out on screens, with field dispatch as the physical tail.

why_ai: Coordination is filed with the FCC under the firm's certification and incumbents trust a neutral coordinator, though the analysis is computable.
why_clarity: Each link is studied by a codified interference method and objections arrive within 30 days.
why_digital: Licence and path data in, studies and filings delivered electronically to clients nationwide.

why_ai: Compiling public operator data is substitutable by AI, but the association's surveys and neutral standing keep some value.
why_clarity: Quarterly operator metrics recur and are checked against reported results.
why_digital: Reports and filings in, databases and research sold online worldwide.

why_ai: Analysis built mainly on public operator reporting faces direct substitution by AI-generated research.
why_clarity: Forecasts recur, but whether a strategy view was right is known slowly and contestably.
why_digital: Public data in, reports and forecasts sold online to a global client base.

why_ai: Auction strategy is adversarial, high-stakes and episodic, and bidders hire trusted economists who testify under their own names.
why_clarity: Every auction is different and valuation methods vary by adviser, though results reveal prices quickly.
why_digital: Auction data and client plans analysed on screens, sold through relationships with a few bidders.

why_ai: Statutory authority to license, auction and enforce stays with accountable public officials.
why_clarity: Procedures are codified, but auctions and spectrum studies are episodic and their outcomes unfold over years.
why_digital: Filings and bids handled on screens by federal bodies serving one jurisdiction.

why_ai: Repair, replacement and device grading are physical logistics, while pricing and claims triage automate.
why_clarity: Claims and trade-ins are high-volume, rule-driven and checked quickly.
why_digital: Physical devices and claims in, repaired or replaced phones and payouts out.

why_ai: Optimisation analysis is being automated by the vendors' own platforms, leaving field and escalation work.
why_clarity: SLA metrics are objective and the same optimisation tasks recur across thousands of sectors.
why_digital: Network data analysed remotely, with some on-site work, sold within large services contracts.

why_ai: An automated API product; its protection is the carrier data licences, not people.
why_clarity: Each check returns a defined answer at very high volume, though fraud outcomes arrive late.
why_digital: Carrier data in, API responses out, sold online to banks and platforms.

why_ai: Leasing forecasts automate, but negotiations with three carrier customers stay relationship-driven.
why_clarity: Leasing outcomes are measurable on tenant records, resolved over contract cycles.
why_digital: Site records and forecasts on screens, used in negotiations with a few large tenants.

why_ai: Coordination is software under FCC certification; the certification, not the people, is the protection.
why_clarity: Grants follow codified protection rules in real time and are checked continuously.
why_digital: Device registrations in, channel grants out, fully automated online.

why_ai: Price and promotion tracking is directly automatable by scraping and AI.
why_clarity: Prices and promotions are objective facts checked continuously.
why_digital: Public offers and surveys in, trackers sold online.

why_ai: Site surveys and stamped professional sign-offs require people at the site who carry the liability.
why_clarity: Per-site reports follow codified federal checklists at high volume.
why_digital: Site visits feed reports delivered electronically to clients across many states.

why_ai: Deal judgement and integration are novel and consequential, and sellers deal with people they trust.
why_clarity: Each acquisition is one-off and its success is known years later.
why_digital: Financial and network data analysed on screens, with deals sourced through relationships.

why_ai: Advocacy depends on relationships and standing with regulators, which AI doesn't substitute.
why_clarity: Policy outcomes are slow and contested; the survey itself repeats annually.
why_digital: Member data and filings handled on screens, with influence exercised in person.

why_ai: Spectrum investment and lease negotiation are rare, high-stakes deals made between known counterparties.
why_clarity: Each transaction is one-off and its value is known only at exit.
why_digital: Licence and market data analysed on screens, with deals negotiated with a few carriers.
